BFA.note: Nothing on authentication, e-signature or remote proof of identity.
Nothing on records passing between the civil register and the ID system.

facts.fact: ONI's Director General cites the latest population and housing census, RGPH 2019, as the source of Burkina Faso's population aged 15 and over (12,477,149).

BFA.note: Gives 10,308,006 registered of 12,477,149 aged 15 and over, not a share of the whole population of all ages.
Nothing on an ID number given at birth.

facts.fact: The new ONI Koudougou antenna produces CNIB cards and is run by 30 ONI production agents and 40 enrolment sites, according to ONI's Director General.

BFA.note: Nothing on other public registers using the ID number.

facts.fact: ONI states 10,308,006 people are registered in its database with a valid CNIB, and its Koudougou antenna produced its first CNIB on 28 December 2023.
